reconciled_architecture.coordination_plane: Prepared Work Items/JOBs and independent Run/RETURN objects are source facts; Agent Network, Control Room, queue/running counts and convergence views are derived projections, not competing mutable authority.
reconciled_architecture.authority_plane: Evidence, Candidate, Human Accepted, Current and Served remain distinct. Workers, Chat Objects, prompts, memory and network projections cannot self-promote product state.
reconciled_architecture.host_boundary: FABRIC/Airlock is the typed admission boundary between candidate-producing cognition and scoped host/owner mutation authority.
reconciled_architecture.continuity_model: A fresh successor must reconstruct identity + state + active method + critical posture from durable heads, then prove continuity through a scoped material action with evidence; fact retrieval alone is insufficient.
reconciled_architecture.project_model: Umbrella Project, Chat Object, Campaign, Workstream, Work Item and Run are distinct typed identities connected by a durable graph; menu aliases and UI position never become identity/authority.
reconciled_architecture.prompt_model: Prompt OS is a deterministic compiled runtime projection of Constitution + METHOD_HEAD + campaign + role/job + Working Set; prompts are not primary durable authority.
reconciled_architecture.bootstrap_model: Public discovery/freshness/job resolution is separated from private context and privileged capability. Narrow revocable scoped capability tokens gate privileged operations; p.txt remains compatibility bootstrap rather than security/semantic source of truth.

integration_decisions.decision: Adopt METHOD_HEAD as a composition pointer/manifest over stable method clauses/modules, not as a mega-prompt or second Constitution.
Keep FOCUS as compact operational cache; Product Memory, Written Book, Canon and Forge remain distinct durable/compiled layers with explicit heads and lineage.
Reuse Context Foundry selection semantics for Source Plane/Working Set and extend them with source revisions, freshness/revalidation, sufficiency and replay-vs-refresh semantics.
Represent Campaign as a durable controller/state machine distinct from Project North and Run; it owns gates, phase transitions, depth, checkpoints and integration timing.
Planner/Compiler compiles intent into dependency DAGs, prepared Work Items/JOBs, critics, return contracts and safe parallel frontiers; execution fabric does not redefine task intent.
Extend Agent Network compiler to ingest Chat Objects/campaigns/JOB-runs-returns/integration and emit Control Room views; do not create a second mutable coordination plane.
Separate logical work identity, dispatch attempt, execution attempt and side-effect receipt; use bounded leases/stale detection and explicit retry/supersession instead of silence-based inference.
Treat RELEASE and WORK_CHECKPOINT as different semantic checkpoints; ZIP/carrier is packaging, not authority. Rollback preserves newer history while selecting a confirmed donor/base.
Require successor parity/proof: deterministic head recovery plus adversarial controls plus at least one scoped material action with durable evidence.
Use immutable returns -> semantic atoms -> scoped/authority-aware clusters -> contradiction graph -> coverage audit -> steward adjudication -> crystallized records/heads as the convergence pipeline.
Keep product apply/update/rollback authority in the scoped host/owner behind Airlock/FABRIC admission; Chat Objects/workers produce candidates/evidence only.
Use one substrate for Prometeo/Facultad/Alumnos/future roots while preserving root-specific identity, privacy, authority and context.

tensions_resolved.resolution: Source Plane preserves/reopens evidence; Product Memory stores durable semantic operating knowledge derived with lineage. Neither replaces the other.
Memory/canon membership does not imply Human Accepted, Current or Served. Canon is campaign execution authority only within its declared gate/scope.
METHOD_HEAD selects active reusable method; Prompt OS compiles the applicable subset plus job/campaign/context into a runtime projection.
Control Room is a richer derived projection over durable source objects and Agent Network/compiler outputs, not a second writer/authority.
Planner compiles executable dependency-aware work; Campaign Controller owns phase/gate/metabolism decisions and invokes/reinvokes planning as state changes.
Work checkpoint preserves continuity without promotion; release is target-confirmed authority movement with evidence/receipts.
Continue resumes from last valid durable gate; it never grants Human Accepted/Current/Served or bypasses required authority.

coverage_audit.survival_set_result: No conflict found with S01-S35 in the 16-return synthesis. High-risk boundaries preserved: durable recovery, no human result courier, immutable worker evidence, one parent/steward integration owner, authority separation, progressive context, preserve-before-invent and explicit rollback/recovery identity.

Their surviving descendants/invariants may guide design but do not create false historical closure.
